newsitem.title: USA: U.S spot MTBE up sharply amid solid blender buying.
newsitem.headline: U.S spot MTBE up sharply amid solid blender buying.

text.p: U.S. spot MTBE prices surged this week, particularly on Thursday amid a flurry of speculative buying by blenders who smelled an opportunity to use undervalued MTBE as an octane blending component.
"Bottom feeders always end up coming out," said one trader in Houston, referring to the speculative blender presence in the market this week.

Traders said MTBE in Houston said MTBE for January delivery got done Thursday as high as 89.50 cents a gallon, after trading at 86.50 early in the day and being pegged at between 83 and 84 cents a gallon a week ago. Estimates on volumes traded ranged from from 100,000 to 200,000.

In New York Harbor, a quiet market compared to Houston, traders said as many as 300,000 prompt barrels have traded in the last three days, with blenders also cited as movers, at values as high as 91.50 cents a gallon, traders said.
Despite the surge, some traders said economics are not very attractive, with prices slightly below production costs.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
